A_offline_vs_online.limitation: Online migration was measured; a destructive offline baseline was not executed.

B_dataset_sizes.limitation: The 13,696-row migration and separate 100,000-row index probe are real; a 1,000,000-row migration was not run.

C_workload_profiles.limitation: Balanced and write-heavy completion events exist; no equivalent read-heavy repeated trial exists.

D_workload_rates.limitation: Observed run summaries are single local trials and do not form a rate sweep.

E_validation_modes.limitation: Full and final-quiesced validation are implemented; sampled validation is not implemented.

F_indexed_queries.limitation: Single local warm-cache observation; use repeated trials before drawing performance conclusions.

G_redis_cache.limitation: One local subprocess-inclusive sample; not a statistically meaningful latency comparison.

H_distributed_query.limitation: One warm local trial; process and Docker overhead dominate this small dataset.

I_interruption_recovery.limitation: Single local experiment; no failover replica is configured.

J_cutover_availability.limitation: One synthetic local cutover; probe durations are bounded by 250 ms sampling precision.

K_resources_and_live_reads.limitation: Thirty read trials after five warm-ups plus one Docker stats snapshot; not a saturation or capacity test.

method.selection: all observed trials retained; no favorable-run filtering

claim_boundary: Sanitized observations from one local development run; not a production, cloud, zero-downtime, or capacity claim.
